original_caption: As drones continue to reshape industries in India, the demand for certified drone pilots has surged. However, operating a drone—especially for commercial purposes—requires more than just technical skills. It demands proper training, regulatory knowledge, and certification from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA). | Eligibility Criteria for Drone Pilot Training Not everyone can operate a drone commercially in India. To obtain a Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC), an individual must meet the following criteria: Minimum Age Requirement: The applicant must be at least 18 years old and not older than 65 years at the time of application. Educational Qualification: A minimum qualification of Class 10 (Matriculation) or equivalent from a recognized board. Medical Fitness: The applicant should be physically and mentally fit to operate a drone safely. Medical Fitness Certificate should be duly signed by a Medical Practitioner  Enrollment in a DGCA-Approved Remote Pilot Training Organization (RPTO): Only RPTOs authorized by the DGCA can provide drone pilot training and issue RPCs. Chapter 4: Drone Pilot Training and
Certification As drones continue to reshape industries in India, the demand
for certified drone pilots has surged. However, operating a
drone—especially for commercial purposes—requires more
than just technical skills. It demands proper training, regulatory
knowledge, and certification from the Directorate General of
Civil Aviation (DGCA). Eligibility Criteria for Drone Pilot Training
Not everyone can operate a drone commercially in India. To
obtain a Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC), an individual must meet
the following criteria:
Minimum Age Requirement: The applicant must be at least 18
years old and not older than 65 years at the time of application.
Educational Qualification: A minimum qualification of Class
10 (Matriculation) or equivalent from a recognized board.
Medical Fitness: The applicant should be physically and
mentally fit to operate a drone safely. Medical Fitness
Certificate should be duly signed by a Medical Practitioner
